name: 30351-longdecode-nemotron12b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of one a3 node.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, bounded at 2048 requests / 1800 s safety, first 10% warmup and last 10% cooldown by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: prompt EXACTLY 128 tokens, output EXACTLY 512 with `ignore_eos`, `request_format: plain` (a raw completion, no chat template), temperature 0.0, static seed 30351.
purpose: A long-form content generator producing 512-token completions from short prompts for 256 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2
trust-remote-code: true
tokenizer-mode: deepseek_v32
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
enable-chunked-prefill: true
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-model-len: 4096
enable-prefix-caching: false
